newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SocGen unit sets A$2 bln mortgage programmes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SocGen unit sets A$2 bln mortgage programmes.

text.p: Societe Generale Australia Ltd said on Thursday it had established a A$1 billion residential mortgage-backed commercial paper programme and a A$1 billion mortgaged-backed medium term note programme.

Societe Generale Australia said the securitisation vehicle would be known as HOMES, Home Owner Morgage Enhanced Securities Ltd. It was intended HOMES would initially issue commercial paper, rated A1-plus by Standard & Poor's.
The medium term notes, designed to satisfy demand from investors for shorter-dated mortgage backed securities, would be issued early in the new year and rated a minimum of AA-minus.
The programme would bestructured, arranged and lead managed by Societe General Australia, it said.
